notes.title: Update 4.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843856/f62b1a16ff69ca0268716e8b5e6d6c3f741a6c31.png[/img]

Hello. If someone found Blueprint Word since its release
probably remember well that she was minimalistic and rather casual
a jigsaw puzzle that was not very friendly
to the player, and also had a number of shortcomings. Game used outdated
at that time, the engine limited us in many aspects. We decided
make some changes and get a little carried away =). Now the game has become
more pleasant in appearance, and also changed the engine to a more modern one, which
subsequently brought diversity, attractive graphics and allowed
us to realize all our ideas.

Here are a few small changes:

Basic:

- Now the game uses Unreal Engine 4 instead of Construct 2.
- All achievements were replaced with new ones.
- In view of some gameplay changes, over 60 levels have been redone
- Supports all screen aspect ratios

Gameplay:

- The basis of the gameplay is the optimization of your moves. In this regard, the "Gears" rotate only in one direction,
so that the passage of all levels has become more intuitive.
- The restriction of moves is set up close. You will not have any moves left.
- Additional extension of the mechanism "Substitute"
- Additional extension of the Teleport mechanism. Now there can be more than one such mechanism at the level of
- Improved mechanism animations
- Added the "Go back" button in the lower corner of the screen. This feature was previously used in the game with the mouse wheel,
but many missed this information
- Most of the cumbersome levels requiring a large number of moves have been replaced by compact but complex
- Added a window of results at the end of the level
- Added a screen for viewing the results when passing the game

Graphic arts:

- New UI button animation
- Redrawn all UI icons
- A choice of 2 new backgrounds

Main menu:

- Changed button layout
- New animation of buttons and other menu items
- All levels are divided into 4 categories for better orientation
- Added a choice of levels, as well as tracking the time spent in each of them
- Now when you delete the save slot - the game asks for permission to do so

Game Settings:

- Updated screen resolution settings. Now you can choose any resolution that your monitor supports.
- Changed viewing modes (Window / window without frames / full screen)
- Added detailed graphics settings
- Added 3 volume controls

SFX:

- Now each mechanism has its own unique sound
- New sounds of UI buttons
- New sounds in the menu

Other:

- Added a preview screen of achievements.


Hot fix from 12/20/19:
- Fixed icons of some buttons in the menu
- Fixed getting Steam achievements

This major update was final and you should no longer expect other global changes from the game, except for fixes.
If you are still not ready to upgrade, you can find the previous version of the game in another branch, in the parameters
Steam
Thank you for being with us. Good luck and Happy New Year to all of you.

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32843856/c9d468a7b3a072a60f98ca5cb51d0d50625cf038.png[/img]

How are the people doing?

Even in these summer, hot days, in the midst of the rest - we are not idle and are actively developing Blueprint Word. And today we are happy to present you the "Summer Update" version 3.0.0.0. This update is global and has many changes and improvements.

The main innovation is the change in the graphic component, which has changed for the better and has become more pleasant to the eye, as well as sound accompaniment, which has given the game a new, unique atmosphere.

[list]
[*] A lot of work was done to replace most graphic elements.
[*] Improved animation of buttons, interactive objects and other elements.
[*] Music! Now there are 4 new songs that will accompany you to the end of the game.
[*] New interface sounds.
[*] Removed all other logos when the game starts. Now at startup, you get straight to the main menu.
[*] Progress - In the save slot, in addition to the percentage of passing time, there was a time spent in a specific save (actual only for game versions 3.0.0.0 and older)
[*] Preferences - now in the game settings there is a section of preferences, where you can set the color of the blink, as well as the colors of the game elements.
[/ list]

Fixes of the previous version:
[list]
[*] Animation of selection of menu items.
[*] Correcting SFX playback
[/ list]

If you have any problems, you can always roll back to previous versions of the game. Have a nice game! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Update 2.0.0.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32843856/db2c1149b5b39316aafcd2379a901a0c00b61faf.png[/img]

Hi! 

We are glad to present you a new update 2.0.0.2 aimed at changing the game interface. 

What's new: 
Since the release version of the game supported only one language (Eng) - this in our opinion led to serious problems in obtaining game experience. 
Not adjusted to all users of the game interface, in particular in the levels of the introduction of new game rules and levels of training, contributed to the emergence of a lack of understanding of the player specific game elements, especially the management and operation of the "mechanisms" provided in the game. 

[list]
[*] At the moment the game got rid of unnecessary information on the screen, especially the text elements of training and completely switched to graphical provision of the information needed by the player. 
[*] There was an opportunity to turn off the so-called "Floating Screen", which gives dynamics to the static scene. This innovation can be found in the "Settings" 
[*] Elements of the main menu are adjusted to a single graphic style. 
[*] Correcting the shortcomings associated with playing SFX 
[/list]

That's all, enjoy the game !!!ːsteamhappyː
